arStrings.szText:
Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|1%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1|%+|"]{/c} Crowd Control Duration and Attack Speed.
